why: Proved: A ⇒ B(1)∧(2)∧(3) (A_to_B123: linear reparametrization = A's affine reparam with b = 0; slices = project lemma IsScPlusSection.pullbackSlice; the convex combination over the square = A's reparam along (τ,t) ↦ t, product rule and sum), and A ⇒ B(4) for g with tame germ data (A_to_B4_tame, after Fgen = paramSection). The gap is B(4)'s hypothesis B.IsScFredholmSection g (Def. 3.14) with PX.IsTame versus A's B.IsScFredholmSectionTame g (Def. 3.51, germ data in a tame chart); the project has no bridge, so (4) for non-tame germ data would need re-proving the general-position argument. B ⇒ A fails: A contains isScPlusSection_of_local, affine reparametrizations and general position under any reindexing ι with s_i = t_{ι(i)}, B only appending.
